label: Scrolling Text
author: Conky-Studio
description: Horizontal marquee for long strings (track titles, status lines). Scrolls when text is wider than the box; otherwise centres.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, W = {x}, {y}, {width}
 local text = tostring({text} or '')
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Sans', CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL)
 cairo_set_font_size(cr, {font_size})
 local ext = cairo_text_extents_t:create()
 tolua.takeownership(ext)
 cairo_text_extents(cr, text, ext)
 local tw = ext.width
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y - {font_size}, W, {font_size} * 1.6)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 if tw <= W then
  local tx = x + (W - tw) / 2 - ext.x_bearing
  cairo_move_to(cr, tx, y)
  cairo_show_text(cr, text)
 else
  local span = tw + {gap}
  local off = (wall_clock() * {speed}) % span
  local tx = x - off - ext.x_bearing
  cairo_move_to(cr, tx, y)
  cairo_show_text(cr, text)
  cairo_move_to(cr, tx + span, y)
  cairo_show_text(cr, text)
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
